stem.text: Which statement for the element in Period 3 and Group 13 of the Periodic Table is correct?

A.text: It has the highest melting point of the elements in its period.

B.text: It has exactly one electron in its shell with principal quantum number 3.

C.text: It forms an oxide that reacts with aqueous sodium hydroxide.

D.text: It forms a chloride that dissolves in water to give a neutral solution.
